messages:
maya: Heads-up — I'm starting the big guides move (guides/* -> platform-guides/*). I split it into 6 smaller PRs to avoid huge diffs. Need review volunteers and a merge ordering so we don't ship broken anchors or stale redirects. TL;DR: each PR adds a redirect rule, moves files, updates internal links, and includes a docs preview.

maya: PR list (rough):
- PR #4212 (landing + root redirects) https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4212 (preview: https://deploy-preview-4212--docs.redwood.com)
- PR #4218 (guides/auth moved) https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4218 (preview: https://deploy-preview-4218--docs.redwood.com)
- PR #4220 (guides/serving -> platform-guides/serving) https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4220
- PR #4227 (sdk snippets + redirects) https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4227
- PR #4230 (anchor fixes across examples) https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4230
- PR #4235 (leftover cross-links + tests) https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4235

maya: Plan proposal: merge order 4212 -> 4218 -> 4220 -> 4227 -> 4230 -> 4235. Why: 4212 establishes site-level redirects so previews for later PRs resolve; then feature-level moves; finally anchor/test fixes. We should keep auto-merge off and merge manually during the doc maintenance window tomorrow 09:00-10:30 PST.

liam: I can review 4218 and 4220. Will check all internal link rewrites.

sophie: I'll take 4227 (sdk snippets) and 4230 (anchor fixes). I want to run the anchor checker locally first.

noah: Quick note — netlify previews will 404 if the redirect isn't merged first, so +1 on your order. Also please add a redirect test in each PR (one assertion).

alex: DevOps: can we freeze the docs site cache during the window? Last time we had stale HTML for 20m. @devops-bot any suggestions?

devops-bot: @alex we can set Cache-Control: no-cache for the preview env during the window. I can patch the CDN rule for 09:00-10:30 PST tomorrow. Will require a signed-off ticket.

priya: For safety, add a small e2e script that runs linkcheck against the preview host after each merge. I threw together scripts/check-anchors.sh (commit in 4235) — it greps for broken anchors and link 404s. Command: `./scripts/check-anchors.sh https://deploy-preview-XXXX--docs.redwood.com`

maya: Good call. Also add this redirect snippet to PR #4212 (Netlify _redirects format):
```
/*   /platform-guides/:splat  301!
```
(we're doing a broad rule then narrowing in later PRs)

rene: I'll do a quick QA sweep after each merge (smoke test: main nav, a couple anchor jumps in guides, SDK code blocks run). Ping me in thread when merged.

liam: One slightly hairy bit: there are a couple of hard-coded absolute links in the marketing pages that point to guides/*. I'll add a small sed patch in 4212 to rewrite them, but want QA on those.

noah: CI notes: docs-preview job will run per PR but we should also trigger full site build after each merge to staging to validate redirects. I'll add a job `staging-full-check` that runs post-merge. It takes ~6m.

maya: Merge ops checklist (short):
- [ ] wait for assigned reviewers to approve
- [ ] ensure redirect rule in 4212 is merged first
- [ ] disable auto-merge and CI auto-rollback for the window
- [ ] devops-bot flips CDN to no-cache
- [ ] merge PRs in order with 5–10m gap, run `./scripts/check-anchors.sh` against latest staging URL
- [ ] rene runs smoke tests and comments done

alex: Can we gate merges on a single approver + docs lead (maya)? Otherwise too risky.

maya: Yes — require 1 reviewer + doc lead approval. I will be the doc lead approver during the window.

sophie: Small gotcha: code sample in guides/serving references `client.predict()` which moved to `client.generate()` in SDK v0.9. Add a compatibility note in 4227. I left a TODO comment in the PR.

priya: Also, to reduce churn for downstream link owners, create a short announcement (one-paragraph) we can post to #general after migration with common old->new mappings. I'll draft it after merge.

maya: Perfect. If reviewers can ack this thread with which PR they own, I'll pin the merge schedule on the PRs. I'll open the signed ticket for CDN change now.

liam: Ack: 4218 + 4220. Will aim to review tonight.

sophie: Ack: 4227 + 4230.

noah: Ack: I'll wire up staging-full-check job and post the run link here when ready.

rene: Ack: QA on standby.

devops-bot: Ticket REDWOOD-3691 created for CDN toggle (owner: devops). ETA for toggle: tomorrow 08:45 PST.

maya: Thanks everyone. I'll update PR descriptions with the merge window and disable auto-merge flags now. Ping here once you've approved a PR so we can sequence merges. :v:
